task_specification.objective: Restore the single authored cemetery package as the authoritative playable arena using a materially different world-space treatment: expand to a larger traversable scale, provide coherent external world/external depth, keep the central building/landmark readable without disappearance or gameplay-relevant occlusion, align collision and perimeter behavior to native geometry during ordinary movement, and complete the required authored upgrade-choice visual hierarchy in the same loop while preserving native Godot boot/project baselines.

diagnosis.root_cause: The intact authored cemetery package is still bounded by a player-visible black external void, and its product-owned outer datum/collision/navigation bindings do not yet provide a stable, sufficiently large traversable composition. Prior camera/transform treatments changed framing but did not supply coherent external world depth or prove aligned movement boundaries.

stop_conditions: Do not duplicate, extract, hide, delete, or reposition authored child meshes or replace native streets with generated roads, floor patches, facades, or landmark packs.

Do not treat a changed camera transform or unchanged bounds as completion; stop candidate work only after a real external-depth/spatial-integrity change and the upgrade-choice presentation behavior are implemented.
Host-owned MCP recapture, four cardinal native-street views, ordinary movement replay, and formal gap/issue verdicts remain validation work.
Do not expand scope into deferred dense-performance, wave-route, or MCP-rebind work.

strategy.rationale: Address the repeated void finding with a world-space composition repair rather than another camera-only transform adjustment: keep one intact authored environment, bind additive outer datum/collision/navigation/spawn/objective anchors to its rendered bounds, and use bounded non-playable cemetery/terrain/fog/silhouette continuity for external depth. In the same coherent product pass, retain the authored upgrade-card transaction and enforce silhouette-led, truthful, focused choices.

code: Run native Godot import/boot/project checks and verify no new parser, resource-load, or runtime errors.

White-box inspect the scene/resource graph for exactly one authored cemetery package, additive outer datum and bindings, no proxy floor replacing native streets, and upgrade presenter rows limited to truthful decision deltas.
Validate collision/navigation coverage against native streets and the central building footprint; verify boundary/perimeter containment and no player/enemy pass-through.
Verify a real horizontal mouse-motion probe changes camera yaw/forward and a vertical probe changes pitch; inspect HUD mouse_filter/event capture if either digest remains unchanged.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester should recapture the authored-composition contract after the repair: spawn, critical route, central-building approach and departure, full perimeter/boundary traversal, and four cardinal first-person views from an interior native street.

Capture runtime state showing one map instance, changed player/camera transforms under ordinary movement, stable landmark visibility, collision contacts, external-depth coverage, and no disappearance/void.

Exercise one upgrade draft with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states, inspect silhouette-led cards and truthful current-to-new deltas, then confirm once and verify exactly-once application plus clean retry/reset.
Run preserved host_godot_boot and native_godot_project checks and formally adjudicate closure of finding.arena_boundary_void and the required authored-cemetery composition gap.
visual: Judge shipped gameplay frames for larger traversable scale, coherent external world/external depth beyond each boundary, native cemetery streets/buildings/props/materials, readable central landmark, aligned ground contact, and absence of black void or proxy/matte edges.

Judge upgrade frames for authored silhouettes/icons, restrained copy, compact truthful deltas, no NEW/LOCKED CURRENT placeholders, and distinct keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states at the configured native viewport and UI scale.
Use sparse viewpoint/state sampling and recapture failed cells first; stop after the bounded retest.

done_when: Exactly one intact authored cemetery package instance remains the sole authoritative visual environment; native streets, buildings, props, materials, and landmarks remain the visible composition.

The playable arena has a real expand change with larger traversable scale, and every tested edge shows coherent external world/external depth rather than a black or empty field; inaccessible dressing does not become reachable gameplay or an unbounded spawn surface.

The central building and every required landmark remain present and readable from the critical route; ordinary movement/movement replay around each side produces no disappearance and no gameplay-relevant occlusion drift.

Authoritative collision matches native streets and the central building footprint; the player and representative enemies cannot pass through geometry, fall beyond the boundary/perimeter, or enter a visible void.
Spawn, objective, navigation, and boundary/perimeter anchors are derived from the same authored datum; unrelated proxy/support clutter is removed or minimized.

Upgrade and weapon choices lead with recognizable silhouettes/authored icons, use compact stat icons, show no more than three truthful current-to-new decision deltas, omit unchanged rows, and never show NEW or LOCKED as a CURRENT value.

Upgrade cards provide distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/pressed/selected/unavailable states without resizing or hiding tradeoffs; confirm is debounced and the applied choice commits exactly once before gameplay resumes and resets cleanly on close/retry.

Focused white-box predicates expose map instance count, authored-datum bindings, collision coverage, camera yaw/pitch response, landmark visibility, and choice transaction state for direct Tester retest, with release-build guards on any diagnostic hooks.
tasks.instructions: Repair the candidate-owned world and choice surfaces. In the existing cemetery scene and spatial contract, preserve the intact authored package as one instance and bind a larger traversable outer datum to the package's rendered bounds. Add only product-owned outer-datum support, collision, navigation, spawn, and objective anchors plus coherent non-playable external world depth (continuing cemetery/terrain/architecture silhouettes, fog, or equivalent authored atmospheric treatment); do not create replacement route-surface, cover, facade, building, landmark-pack, generated-road, or floor-patch families. Ensure central building/landmark collision, navigation exclusion, camera sight lanes, and perimeter/boundary behavior agree in one transform space so ordinary movement cannot pass through, cause disappearance, or expose an occlusion/void edge. Keep the high-angle camera responsive to real horizontal and vertical mouse probes and prevent full-screen HUD mouse filtering from swallowing them. In the upgrade draft scene/presenter and directly related catalog adapter, keep the authored card layout but make the visual hierarchy silhouette-first with compact icon/value rows, truthful current-to-new deltas capped at three, no placeholder CURRENT values, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus plus exactly-once commit/reset lifecycle. Add deterministic tester-only predicates or receipts only where needed for direct black-box/white-box retest; guard them from release exports.
